Descartar los hechos que solo repiten el: Drop facts that only restate the brain's subject
Tras ingerir una propuesta, el decisor p: After a proposal is ingested, the default decider judges the new facts that name the brain's subject and drops, with no person reviewing them, those that only restate it (with a confidence of at least its threshold, and never below 0.8). At most 10 calls per ingestion. A dropped fact does not come back: turn it on only once the decider is calibrated.
